pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain trades healing for faster damage; Grace cleanses allies; Bounty adds kill-loot chances; Chaos creates a rooting parasite blossom and an ending ally buff.
